data.name: Little Horror
data.description: The Core tried to remember the ship's mascot. This is what came back: a small, damp thing with one tooth too many, and it has decided you are its crew.
data.artDirection: small, oddly cute rot-and-skyglass creature, the Core's bad copy of the ship's mascot.
rankConcepts: A palm-sized blob of dark, wet rot with big round eyes and one tooth too many, a tarnished brass bell on a frayed rope collar, sitting in a puddle of bilge water
A small rot blob grown four stubby legs and a lopsided grin of too many teeth, flecks of cloudy skyglass in its skin, the brass bell on its rope collar
A dog-sized rot creature with a ragged rope-like tail and a wide toothy mouth, small barnacle clusters of cloudy skyglass along its back
A hound-sized rot beast with damp, timber-dark hide and a crest of cloudy skyglass shards down its spine, sitting like a loyal dog, bell at its neck
A lean rot beast on four powerful legs, ribs of old ship timber showing through, a maw that splits too wide, skyglass shards on its shoulders
A large rot beast collared in scraps of rope and sailcloth, its mouth ringed with skyglass teeth, the brass bell now small against its throat
A horse-sized rot beast whose back has grown a ridge of clear skyglass crystal, a second, smaller maw on its chest, eyes still big and devoted
A towering rot beast of wet timber and tar-black rope, rows of skyglass spines, a half-open maw in its chest, crouched protectively
A huge skyglass rot-beast with a cracked ship's figurehead fused into its brow, barnacled rot armour, the old bell still on its rope collar
A colossal skyglass rot-beast, its body clouded crystal over dark rot, a maw full of crystal teeth, the tiny brass bell still at its neck, still loyal

data.name: Little Maw
data.description: The Little Horror opens a mouth far too big for its body and bites, leaving the target easier to hurt for a round.
data.battleDescription: %user opens a maw far too big for its body and bites down on %target.

data.name: The Little Horror's Jar
data.description:
One of the Skyglass Project's first recalls was the ship's mascot, sealed in a jar. The Core tried to remember it. This is what came back.

Open the jar to bind the Little Horror to you as a pet. It answers to you, not to the crown.
The jar will not open while your pet collection is full. It stays in your inventory until you make room.

effects.description: The Little Horror's Jar: binds the Little Horror to you as a pet
